name: Zapier inbound → outbound bridge
description: Receive a Zap webhook payload, transform it via a project tool, and forward the result to a downstream HTTP endpoint. Pure no-LLM bridge — deterministic glue between two webhook-shaped systems.
rationale_at_seed: Inbound webhook on `/zapier-in` → tool_call passthrough → outbound POST. Zero LLM calls — the bridge is deterministic.
tool_name `passthrough` is the canonical no-op tool the F2-3 registry exposes (echoes its arguments back). Demonstrates the tool_call node without depending on a heavy integration.
tunnel_uuid is the zero-uuid placeholder; catalog [Add] rebinds at seed time.
Timeout 60s is tight on purpose — bridges should fail fast so upstream retries kick in.
Zero `required_connections` from Composio / channels — only the downstream HTTP connection. Highlights that webhook-bridge workflows can ship without any chat-channel coupling.
